# Vendored Mermaid

Mermaid 11.12.0 browser bundle, downloaded with explicit permission for diagram dependencies only.

Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mermaid/-/mermaid-11.12.0.tgz

Installation verified the package bytes against the npm registry's SHA-512 dist.integrity value before extraction. mermaid.min.js and LICENSE are unmodified package files. The local renderer hashes the bundle as part of its SVG cache key.

No npm dependencies, browser binaries, Java, Maven or other runtimes were installed. The existing Chrome renders the bundle with HTTP/HTTPS requests blocked. The final reader embeds SVG, not this runtime bundle, and needs no network connection.
